# spec-006 T0/T8/AC2 — copy preservation snapshot, pre-restyle.
#
# IMPORTANT deviation from tasks.md's literal wording: tasks.md/spec.md claim
# browser_setup_screen.dart already contains "Carica l'estensione beta",
# "Registra Native Messaging Host", "Ho fatto", "Estensione caricata ✓",
# "Incolla". A full-file read + `grep` across lib/ before this spec's changes
# found ZERO occurrences of any of those five strings anywhere in the repo.
# The real current screen implements a different, more advanced distribution
# model (Chrome Web Store listing with a fixed extension id +
# BrowserSetupService.installNativeHost() one-click automated installer),
# not the mock's "unpacked beta extension + paste id + copy terminal
# command" model. Flagged to the human via `mcp_Question`; decision was to
# restyle only (keep the real flow/copy, do not introduce the mock's five
# strings). This fixture therefore snapshots the REAL pre-restyle literals
# so T8's restyle cannot silently change them, instead of the five strings
# named in tasks.md (which do not exist to preserve).
#
# Same convention as strings_003/004/005_before.txt: interpolated literals
# are recorded as their fixed surrounding segments.
